hero.title: See how NosiFit brings training, nutrition and recovery together
hero.lead: This is a realistic NosiFit dashboard preview. It shows what you can log every day and how those entries become a clear picture of your current state.

dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.description: This is not a collection of isolated mockups. It is one day in context: training, nutrition, recovery and balance history work together.

heatmap.title: Your rhythm over the last weeks
heatmap.description: Each cell shows the overall balance for a day. In the real dashboard, you can open a day to see training, recovery and nutrition details.

training.title: Today's workout
training.description: The session keeps the same structure as the real dashboard: exercises, sets, reps and load. The demo checkboxes are interactive.

nutrition.title: What you ate today
nutrition.description: Meals open the same way as the dashboard widget: a compact summary first, then individual foods and macros.

recovery.title: Sleep and body state
recovery.description: Recovery is more than one number. NosiFit places sleep, energy and stress next to training load.

habits.title: Daily actions
habits.description: Habits turn recovery into concrete daily actions. You can toggle them in this demo.

recommendation.title: Keep today's intensity moderate
recommendation.text: Recent training load is stable and recovery looks good. You can train, but avoid a sudden increase in volume. After training, pay attention to sleep and hydration.
recommendation.note: The recommendation is based on the context of the day, not one metric.

register.title: These data become yours
register.text: You can log your own workouts, meals, water, sleep and recovery habits. NosiFit brings them into one dashboard and shows how they change over time.

guide.title: One day — one clear picture
guide.text: NosiFit is not just a collection of numbers. You log the important parts of your day and the dashboard brings them into one context.

training.title: Log your workout
training.text: Add exercises, sets and reps. The session shows what you actually did today and the load you received.

nutrition.title: Track your nutrition
nutrition.text: Add meals, foods, water and weight. This gives you a view of the whole day instead of isolated meals.

recovery.title: Support recovery
recovery.text: Sleep and recovery habits help you understand whether your body is ready for the next training load.

analysis.title: See the trend
analysis.text: The heatmap turns individual days into a history. Open a day to connect training, recovery and nutrition.

explainer.title: Your data does not stay isolated
explainer.text: As you regularly log training, food and recovery, NosiFit can show more than what happened today. It can make relationships between those inputs visible.

data.title: You log facts
data.text: Exercises, meals, water, sleep and habits are simple entries you can add throughout the day.

context.title: The dashboard adds context
context.text: The system puts those entries together so training load, nutrition and recovery can be understood in one place.

trend.title: The heatmap shows history
trend.text: Day by day, your balance becomes a history. That makes changes easier to notice than judging progress from a single day.
